label: FSL fslchfiletype
description:
Convert file format using a separate output, never overwrite the source.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: format
parameters.description: Output type; this interface writes NIfTI.
parameters.usage: Output type; this interface writes NIfTI. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: Input image. Choose an existing file; the command never modifies it.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Convert file format using a separate output, never overwrite the source. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
